_comment: Central school directory consumed by every Codex mobile app's onboarding/bootstrap flow. Each app fetches this file from https://waypoints.schoolcodex.com/schools.json, lets the user pick their school by name/code, then cross-checks the entry against that school's own /.well-known/<app>-codex.json before storing the API base + cert pins.
_schema_v2: v2 is ADDITIVE and backward compatible on purpose. `well_known` and `min_app_version` keep their v1 TYPES (plain strings, teacher values) because a shipped app parses them as strings; do not turn either into a per-app object. Per-app values live in the `well_known_by_app` / `min_app_version_by_app` maps, which older clients ignore. A client reads its own key from the map and falls back to the flat field. See README.md.

schools.name: Codex Demo School
schools._comment: Sandbox instance for app-store review and staff training. Fictitious data only — not a real school.
